rows.title: If a native .json résumé's own "name" is not a string, the editor and Dashboard crash on every visit and every synced device, or Rename stops working
rows.summary: Now: normalizeResume (withTextFields) stores the record's own name as text: a number as its digits, a list as its text, and an object, blank or missing name as 'Untitled Resume' ('Cover Letter' for a letter). The card, editor header, Rename, Delete prompt and /new all get text; a name that is already text is kept exactly.

review.notes: 61cdf4e3 fixes the root cause at the one place every record comes in (normalizeResume via withTextFields: load, import, cloud-sync merge, other-tab reload, demo restore, public page), so no card, editor header, Rename, Delete prompt, /new or duplicate can meet a non-text name. The failfirst check in run 36644524664 is real: the test fails without the fix (3 of 4 cases; the fourth checks that a text name is kept exactly and that a second load returns the same object) and passes with it. The full node suite (6 shards) and lint are green on d517ab91 in run 36645314956. Side effects checked: updatedAt is left alone, so the added name causes no sync write and wins no merge, and every device normalises the same way; the new imports (letters.js, newResume.js) create no import cycle; a letter with no name becomes 'Cover Letter'; the v13 old-letter migration still sees 'Cover Letter' names unchanged; renameResume already rejects blank names, so for stored data the only change is that a blank or whitespace-only name now shows 'Untitled Resume', which is intended; PublicResume and export file names read personal.name and are unaffected. Build, Playwright and Cypress were not run: this is a data-only change to a util, and the batch gate covers them.

notes: CI run 36644524664 (failfirst + named tests incl. guards 31/71/91 and knowledge-docs) was still running when this report was written; its result must be read back before merge.
